title: Checking out your ignite Talk I can post the link, you tried to embed your slides but you need to use an iframe, if you go to file->publish to the web
summary: Checking out your ignite Talk I can post the link, you tried to embed your slides but you need to use an iframe, if you go to file->publish to the web->and then to share you can get the link. Also you left the video element blank which is why you see the "no video warning"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Checking out your ignite Talk I can post the link, you tried to embed your slides but you need to use an iframe, if you go to file->publish to the web->and then to share you can get the link. Also you left the video element blank which is why you see the "no video warning"
